name: dynamsoft-sdk
description: AI agent skills for integrating Dynamsoft SDKs: barcode scanning, MRZ, document capture, Web TWAIN scanning and document viewing.

interface.longDescription: Skills that write correct, current integration code for the Dynamsoft SDKs: barcode and QR scanning on web, mobile and server, MRZ and passport parsing, document boundary detection and normalization, physical scanner acquisition with Dynamic Web TWAIN, and in-browser document viewing with Document Viewer. Covers JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET, Java, C++, Node.js, Android, iOS, Flutter and React Native, plus migration from other scanning libraries and template tuning for hard barcode images. Each skill prefers the Capture Vision core API over the ready-to-use wrappers, initializes licensing from an environment variable, and points at the matching official sample.
capabilities: Write barcode and QR scanning integration code
Parse MRZ from passports and ID cards
Control physical scanners from the browser
Render and annotate documents in a web app
Migrate from ZXing, ML Kit or Scandit
defaultPrompt: Add a barcode scanner to my web app
Read MRZ from a passport image in Python
Move this app from ZXing to Dynamsoft
